find_raw.episode_notes: A Telugu comedy web series following Prasad, an eccentric, shameless young man navigating awkward romantic encounters with Vaishu (Bhramara), Pooja, Pratheeksha, and Virajitha. After getting rejected repeatedly and finding out his love interests are either married, engaged, or related, he faces a surprise twist at the end. The final revelation in L0888-L0918, where Vaishu cancels her wedding to aggressively claim Prasad, would spoil the ending if clipped out of sequence.

payoffs.reason: Vaishu hysterically confronts her boyfriend for gifting her 'ORS sachets' for her birthday instead of standard romantic gifts.
Vaishu vents her disbelief that her boyfriend sent a bouquet saying 'thatha happy anniversary' on her grandfather's death memorial.
The boyfriend defends gifting sanitary pads for Valentine's Day because she literally told him she was on a period 'date'.
When asked to take her somewhere romantic, the boyfriend takes her to Secunderabad railway station because the 'cheraku rasam' (sugarcane juice) is good.
Vaishu brutally punctures her boyfriend's romantic bus flashback by pointing out that bus rides are free for women.
Prasad justifies why women shouldn't call him 'anna' with a darkly absurd tale about eating lunch at the funeral of the last girl who did.
Asked if he has a girlfriend, Prasad deadpans that he does, but she is currently 'with someone else.'
Just as Prasad starts hitting on Pooja as a backup, she drops the shocking truth that she is already married.
Prasad casually suggests 'killing her husband' and finding a lawyer so they won't get caught after learning Pooja is married.
Prasad roasts Pooja's eccentrically dancing husband by asking why an 'item song' is interrupting their love story.
Prasad calls out Vaishu's philophobia by stating that pushing people away is pure cowardice rather than a mental illness.
Prasad hilariously compares Pratheeksha finally giving him attention to an old 'insurance policy' that just matured.
Pratheeksha builds up a tender confession only to hilariously bro-zone Prasad by saying 'you are like my brother.'
A female coworker complains to the boss that Prasad is blackmailing her with a marriage proposal if she doesn't lend him twenty thousand rupees.
When her husband preaches that spouses should blend like milk and water, Vaishu retorts that mixing water in milk is just adulteration.
Vaishu delivers a sharp threat to her husband, warning him that if he digs into her past, she will dig his grave.
Vaishu mocks her husband's lawyer credentials by telling him that without his black coat, he couldn't even run a bajji stall.
Told that he speaks cheaply, Prasad cheekily offers to speak in English if she gives him two hundred rupees.
Told her match is a teetotaler, Prasad ridiculously misinterprets it as a drunkard who mixes brandy into tea.
Prasad mocks the cliché of finding a better girl by quipping that he should hire the archaeology department to dig one up.
Hearing that Virajitha is marrying a lawyer too, Prasad cynically observes that they can argue their own divorce case.
After Virajitha compares him to a pig, Prasad exposes her ignorance of liquor brands and snaps back that he won't compare her to animals.
Vaishu shocks Prasad by declaring her love through a psycho-possessive threat to either kill herself or murder him if he looks at anyone else.
